name: Dûnyain Rationality
laws: Pursue the Absolute through rational discipline
What comes before determines what comes after (causation-first metaphysics)
Emotional attachments are obstacles to clarity
Foresight is achieved by probability-trance; the rational mind calculates the future
costs: Foresight becomes its own cage — the Thousandfold Thought constrains Kellhus himself
Rationality weaponized severs you from the community of the unready
limits: Cannot fully escape the fabric of the Onta
Cannot anticipate the truly alien (the Consult, the No-God)
examples: Kellhus's seduction of Serwë and Leweth in Darkness That Comes Before

name: Sorcerous Mark
laws: Using sorcery leaves a visible stain (the Mark) on the soul
The stronger the sorcerer, the heavier the Mark
Chorae (trinkets) kill any marked sorcerer on contact
costs: Eternal: damnation is the stated cost
Social: sorcerers are marked visible to anyone with sight for souls
limits: Cannot be evaded by avoiding Chorae in mortal life; death is the issue
Psukhari (Cishaurim) work magic without Mark — narrative counter-example that proves the rule
examples: Akka's constant awareness of his Mark
